# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1997

**Appropriation for Overdraft and RATA Increase**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates ₱309,123.50 for the overdraft in appropriation by the end of fiscal year [[1997]] and to increase the Representation and Transportation Allowance (RATA) of all municipal officials of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It also covers the reversion of obligated appropriations from the annual budget of [[1997]] and Supplemental Budget No. 01 of [[1997]]. The ordinance approves the revision of appropriation indicated in Supplemental Budget No. 02.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section I. Reverts obligated appropriation from the Annual Budget of [[1997]] and Supplemental Budget No. 01 of [[1997]] with a total amount of ₱309,788.00. Appropriates ₱309,123.50 for the overdraft in appropriation by the end of Fiscal Year [[1997]] and increase of RATA of all Municipal Officials of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  Section II. Approves the Revision of Appropriation indicated in the Supplemental Budget No. 02 prepared by the Municipal Mayor.
3.  Section III. Makes Supplemental Budget No. 02 prepared by the Municipal Mayor an integral part of the ordinance, marked as "Annex A".
4.  Section IV. States that the ordinance shall take effect upon approval.
5.  Section V. Adopted on September 22, [[1997]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
